# listNoteCategoryTypes — GET /notes/categoryTypes

List note category types

## Verified behaviors

- **Listing category types is refused for this key** — Every request from the research key is refused with 403 FORBIDDEN before anything else happens, so the live vocabulary of assignableTypes has never been observed — the documented 200 comes from the official docs alone. ([replay](../behaviors/note-category-types-restricted-for-this-key.md))

## Behavior

Returns the entity types a note category can be assigned to — the vocabulary of `NoteCategory.assignableTypes` — as a **bare JSON array of strings**, with no pagination envelope.

The official docs state that "in almost all cases" the available types are `Event`, `Location`, `Person` and `Organization`, and give `["Person", "Organization", "Event", "Location"]` as the example response. They are singular and PascalCase. Because a context can in principle expose a different set, this endpoint is the authoritative list for a given context and the schema below does not close the set with an `enum`.

**This action is restricted for the key used to research this spec.** Every request returns 403 FORBIDDEN "Access to this action is restricted", so the live response has never been observed — the 200 below comes from the official docs.

## Example

```bash
curl -sS -X GET \
  'https://api.securevan.com/v4/notes/categoryTypes' \
  -u "app-name:$NGP_API_KEY|1"
```
